text_to_speech: i've done the sculpture of the prime minister because as you can see he's a quite a popular gentleman everybody likes him i really liked his features and i decided to do it and i have to say i'm very thrilled first by his reaction and he's obviously so easy going and i could not believe my uh improvisation the last minute where not having had glasses because somebody said where are the glasses so i took off his own glasses put it on which i thought was was a good move he was happy i believe and i hope everybody from india and elsewhere will like the features and hopefully find that it is complementary to what the prime minister looks like i mean i have to say i was impressed before speaking to him he spoke to every single person and he gave every single person the time necessary to respect them to give them the time to respond and he had the kind word for every single person this is number one number two you know as you can see i never met him before but he automatically immediately was so uh made me feel at ease to speak to him like like a brother really and i have to say this is we're all human beings it doesn't matter if you are prime minister or the pope we are all humans and that's why we give respect to each other and and regardless of our level and i that's why i have a lot of respect for him

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I've done the sculpture of the Prime Minister because as you can see he's a quite a popular gentleman, everybody likes him.
I really liked his features and I decided to do it.
I have to say I'm very thrilled, first by his reaction and his obviously so easy going.
And I could not believe my improvisation the last minute where not having had glasses because somebody said where are the glasses?
So I took off his own glasses, put it on which I thought was a good move.
He was happy I believe and I hope everybody from India and elsewhere will like the features and hopefully find that it is complimentary to what the Prime Minister looks like.
Before I was speaking to him he spoke to every single person and he gave every single person the time necessary to respect them, to give them the time to respond.
And he had the kind word for every single person. This is number one.
Number two, as you can see I never met him before but he automatically immediately was so made me feel at ease to speak to him like a brother really.
And I have to say this is we all human beings, it doesn't matter if you are Prime Minister or the Pope, we are all humans.
And that's why we give respect to each other and regardless of our level.
And that's why I have a lot of respect for him.
